content:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty Alert fired -> alert_id=PDR-34921 host=gpu-node-42 region=us-west-2 symptom=kernel_panic kubelet_status=NotReady
pagerduty: PDR-34921 triggered by threshold: host heartbeat lost + kubelet notready. Auto-escalation to SRE oncall.

sarah-ops: acked PDR-34921. I'm taking primary. quick check: any customer impact reports?

jay-oncall: seeing spike in 5xx from a few envs (prod-eu, prod-usw). Load balancer retried, some requests queued. Not full outage but higher error rate ~6% on inference route /v1/generate.

mike-infra: confirmed node is unreachable via kubelet. SSH attempts time out. BMC/serial shows sudden kernel oops followed by machine reboot loop.

rachel-sre: marking host cordoned in k8s: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-42` and starting evacuation of pods. Will attempt graceful drain but pods with local GPUs will failover.

sarah-ops: good. I'm updating PD with timeline + impact. Notifying CS to prep customer message for top 3 customers hitting errors.

jay-oncall: rolling routing policy to fallback: set route preference for model-group=stable -> prefer us-west-1 and us-east-1 for 10m. Command: `rwctl routes set --model stable --prefer us-west-1,us-east-1 --ttl 600`

mike-infra: attempted serial console capture: dmesg shows `NMI: kernel panic - not syncing: GPU watchdog timeout` then `kworker` trace. NVMe SMART shows no clear error. Possible driver hang + PCI reset.

rachel-sre: draining note: `kubectl drain gpu-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m` — two critical inference pods didn't evict cleanly, restarted on fallback nodes but longer cold-start time observed.

sarah-ops: customer impact summary for PD entry: degraded inference for small subset of customers in us-west-2 for ~7 minutes, elevated 5xx rate ~6%, latency increased for rerouted requests. No data plane breach. CS notified - they'll send acknowledgement to affected customers with ETA for fix.

pagerduty: PDR-34921 auto-escalated to L2 after 5m without stable recovery.

jay-oncall: I've increased dedicated pool capacity in us-west-1 by +2 GPUs (`infractl capacity scale --pool dsp-usw1 --add 2`) to absorb traffic. Monitoring token spend and latency.

mike-infra: hardware intervention: scheduled IPMI power cycle for gpu-node-42; if it fails to stay up, we'll open a hardware replacement ticket with vendor. Also flagged for full kernel-abi logs collection.

sarah-ops: handoff to Jay in 15m for continued mitigation & hardware follow-ups. Creating incident channel #inc-34921. Postmortem owner: rachel-sre.

rachel-sre: quick triage notes to include in postmortem: reproduce? can't reproduce in staging. Likely regression in kernel driver + specific NV firmware + kernel combination; need to cross-check recent node image rollouts.

jay-oncall: ack handoff. Oncall takeover: monitoring for replays, will keep routing preference for 15m and then revert if stable. Will coordinate hardware replacement if node fails next boot.

sarah-ops: Incident timeline updated in PD. Adding tags: gpu, kernel-panic, kubelet-notready, routing-fallback.

mike-infra: node came back online after ipmi cycle but kubelet remained CrashLoopBackOff for the GPU driver pod. I applied kernel module reload and re-applied nvidia-driver daemonset. Kubelet transitioned to Ready at +18m.

rachel-sre: validating cluster health: nodes healthy, pods rescheduled, 5xx rate falling to baseline. Will run synthetic prompt evictions to ensure model quality not affected.

sarah-ops: closing PD incident to acknowledge mitigation, keeping internal incident channel open for postmortem. CS will send follow-up to affected customers in ~30m.

jay-oncall: next steps: collect kernel+nv driver logs, prepare RCA draft, check for similar kernel oops in last 24h across fleet. If pattern, push automated filter to autoreplace nodes failing kworker trace.

rachel-sre: adding one action item: add a health-check to route-level that detects sustained kubelet restarts and triggers faster routing fallback.

sarah-ops: thanks everyone. leaving notes + handoff complete. :white_check_mark:

incidentbot: PDR-34921 marked resolved by sarah-ops.

pagerduty: PDR-34921 resolved at 2607779150.
